【SSS-Rank AI System detected. User found. Mission initializing…】
When he opened his eyes again, everything had changed.
He had returned ten years into the past. Back when his family was still rich. Back when he still had a chance to rewrite everything.
This time, he won’t be weak.
This time, he’ll rise stronger, richer, and unstoppable.
As for the girl who once crushed his heart? Now, she can’t take her eyes off him… unaware that the man she rejected has become a legend in the making.
With the power of the SSS-Rank AI System, he’ll build a new destiny.
And no one will ever dare look down on him again.
stealing-the-heavens: An unexpected discovery in Machu Picchu has transported a young professional thief from Earth to a world filled with mystical powers and evil plots. With his beloved teacher and best friend killed during the calamity, his only goal is to become stronger, so that he can take revenge for them.This is a novel filled with politics, the struggle for power, evil beauties, and of course, Divine Immortals.
supreme-magus-novel:
DerekMcCoy was a man that since from young age had to face many adversities.
Often forced to settle with surviving rather tha living, had finallyfound his place in the world, until everything was taken from him onelast time.
After losing his life to achieve revenge, he reincarnatesuntil he finds a world worth living for, a world filled with magic andmosters.
Follow him along his journey, from grieving brother to aliensoldier.
From infant to Supreme Magus.
tenkomori-the-homecoming-club-conquers-a:
“I have a home to go back to.”
Mori Tenko is the self-proclaimed ace of the going-home club. He tries to set a new record on his usual route home from school, but gets hit by a truck when he tries to save a strange puppy.
Then he’s picked up by a fat old man who calls himself a god, and is sent to a different world called Veriathes, where swords, magic, and skills rule the world, and where he is told to live out his life cheerfully and happily.
As soon as he arrives there, Norimi is subjected to a harsh baptism. Realizing that the world is not easy, he throws himself into battle, training himself to survive and protect his place in the world.
This is the story of a young man who later became known as the Lord of the Deep Temple and shook the world.
the-betrayed-heiresss-second-comeback:
The night that was supposed to be the peak of my life became the night I lost everything.
My step-sister Rose stole my achievements.
My fiancé chose her over me.
My father handed over the company I built with my own hands… to her.
And when I finally walked away, broken and exhausted, Karl followed me home—drunk, furious, and ready to destroy what little I had left.
One blow to the head was all it took to end Jenna Harvour.
At least, that’s what the world was meant to believe.
I didn’t die.
I woke up drugged, half-conscious, and listening to people decide how to “dispose” of me. I heard Rose’s voice ordering my death to be written off as suicide.
I heard doctors bargaining over my body.
And when I was finally strong enough to open my eyes, I was greeted by a stranger’s face and a new name forced onto me: Jenna Lorance.
They buried my old identity.
They held a funeral with my name on it.
And I was expected to disappear quietly into this new life they created.
But the world doesn’t get rid of me that easily.
My unexpected lifeline comes in the form of Damian Black—the heir to the largest mafia syndicate and the last person I ever thought would notice me.…
the-fallen-hero-reincarnates-as-the-demo:
only led to his death.
But fate had other plans.
Reincarnated as the son of the strongest being in existence, the Demon King. One might expect him to resist, to rebel against the Demon King and kill him once and for all.
But why bother?
Being the good guy led to nothing but betrayal and death. This time, he'll live for himself. Women, pleasure, power—he will claim it all, as any true demon would.
the-king-of-special-warfare:
He rose from abjection and achieved eternity in glory.
He embraced the prettiest beauties and killed the strongest opponents.
He was able to shift the clouds into rain and cover the sky with one hand.
He could overrun the entire world and go anywhere as he pleased.
He pacified wars and held the world in awe.
He was matchless in the world.
However, his hair turned white overnight for his beloved woman and he was on the verge of death.
He was surrounded by enemies who were trying to take his life.
He struggled his way to become mighty and fought for everything he cherished.
For this age, he was the only king of the Dark World.
His name was a byword for might.
As a man living in the world, his only ideal was to pursue brilliance.
the-last-rule-of-death:
Five years after the Rupture broke the world, humanity didn't end. It adapted. People still complained about coffee prices and argued online; they just did it while checking monster-alert applications.
Eighteen-year-old Etzel Deymar just wanted to finish his morning run. Instead, he stumbled upon an Ancient Ability Tree and received the System’s idea of a punchline: [Ability Awakened: Limited Necromancer] [Rank: F] [Level: 0]
No army of the undead. No instant legendary spells. Just a F-Rank class that punishes mistakes and a System that seems actively disappointed in him.
But Etzel quickly realizes that the System isn't just a game of numbers; it's an ancient, rigid architecture. And every architecture has a flaw.
Armed with a forestry hatchet, a pragmatic mindset, and a summoned amnesiac knight in overly bright silver armor who critiques his footwork, Etzel begins to rewrite the rules of death. He doesn't enslave souls; he builds Soul Architecture. He doesn't just level up; he engineers his own survival through contracts, consent, and the terrifying art of finding the “First Flaw” in his enemies.…
the-modern-martial-immortal:
A Martial Dao grandmaster stands at the limit of the human body, capable of facing a hundred foes alone, founding sects, and leaving behind a legacy. Yet that is only the peak of mortals.
A human immortal is something greater. They stride through the void, ride the wind, wander the seas by dawn and stand upon the peaks by dusk. Detached from the mortal world, they feast on wind and drink dew, living long and carefree. This is humanity’s ultimate romance.
Are immortals merely fiction? Do they not exist in the real world? The Martial Dao defies the heavens and turns the impossible into reality. So if I wish to become a human immortal, to roam the seas at dawn and reach the peaks by night, what could be wrong with that?
the-parent-trap:
Carly Lewis woke up alone and confused in the hospital three years ago without any memory of who she is or what her name was. One day she saves a little girl, and a glimmer of a memory appears in her mind she decides to follow the girl and her father to find out who she is... She needed answers...
Carly soon realizes her past isn’t what she thought it was but it was already too late her past was going to hurt more than just her...
Now, as enemies close in and shocking truths unravel, Carly must discover who she really is before her past destroys the only family, she’s ever wanted.
the-quietest-knife:
Willow Hale survives the crash. Miles was driving. Nothing happened to him.
That should have been the worst part.
She wakes up in a hospital bed to find her life has already been reassigned. Miles stands beside her, calm and composed, holding another woman's hand. His boss's daughter. Christy Cordell.
He explains everything to the doctors with quiet confidence. According to him, they broke up weeks before the accident. It was mutual. He only stayed out of decency.
Then he adds one more detail.
Willow ended things because she had already started seeing someone else. Zane. Miles's best friend. The one man in the room who could destroy the lie with a single sentence.
Instead, Zane gives a small nod.
Drugged, injured, and surrounded by people repeating the same story, Willow understands too late what is happening. One careless joke about being confused after the crash gives Miles the perfect excuse to turn betrayal into fact.
In one quiet, clinical moment, her engagement disappears. Her memories are dismissed. Her heartbreak is recorded as trauma.
So Willow stops arguing. She stops crying. She lets them believe she is weak.…
the-rise-of-the-no-1-hunter:
In a world where nearly everyone manifests magical powers by fifteen, Rikue Raito never did.
No mana. No rank. No future.
While others became Hunters, diving into dungeons and rising through the ranks, Raito stayed behind, cleaning their weapons for pocket change.
Three years passed.
He was mocked. Ignored. Left behind.
Even Ayane, the girl he once promised to fight beside, started to lose faith.
But everything changed the day his power finally manifested.
Now, Raito doesn’t need to catch up.
He doesn’t need to follow anyone’s path.
Now the ones who looked down on him…
will have to watch him rise.
the-sss-legendary-dragon-chose-me-on-reb:
They called the Vorrakyns Dragon Riders, but their legacy has crumbled into dust. For centuries, no true Dragon has answered their call.
Vacuse Vorrakyn was born into a dying legacy: once-mighty, now feared and cast to the Empire’s edge.
A runt. A bastard. Yet he served his family with fierce loyalty, only to be betrayed by the father he once swore to obey. Vacuse died a pawn... a sacrifice to the forbidden magic to call a true Dragon.
Discarded like worthless trash.
Now, he’s back.
Reborn at six, memories of betrayal burning sharp and anger raging in his veins. This time, he’s here to claim what was stolen and everything they denied him.
Armed with forbidden knowledge of the Dragon Pathway and the secrets to bond with a legendary beast, Vacuse is determined to rebuild the family legacy—on his own terms.
the-substitution-of-the-shield-hero:
The Shield Hero, Naofumi Iwatani... That wasn't me.
Still, it was a convenient name.
It seemed like I died and was summoned in his place.
Poor choice.
For the world, that is.
the-triplet-alphas-are-hers:
Seren never wanted to be noticed. As the daughter of the royal medicine woman, she learned early that survival meant keeping her head down and her mouth shut. The palace was no place for curiosity, especially not when the dying King's three sons prowled its halls like caged predators.
Prince Aeron, cold and calculating, leads with ruthless precision. Prince Kael, the soldier, obeys instinct over law. Prince Theron, charming and dangerous, sees through every lie. They are identical in face but opposite in nature, and the kingdom holds its breath waiting to see which one will claim the throne.
When Seren witnesses a royal execution she was never meant to see, she becomes a problem the triplets cannot afford. Too dangerous to release, too innocent to kill, she finds herself confined in their private wing as political tensions threaten to tear the kingdom apart. But something unexpected happens when the princes get too close. The ancient mating bond, which should only form between wolves, sparks to life between a human servant and three alpha heirs.
Now Seren is caught in a bond that defies nature and law.…
the-villainous-noblewoman-is-about-to-be:
The Fake Life of a Villainess:
Reincarnated as a villainous noblewoman, you become an experience bag for the protagonist on their journey. You are the target of the maid’s revenge, your half-sister takes away everything that belongs to you, and the grand princess who cared for you for many years finally loses hope and abandons you.
The Real Life of a Villainess:
You clean up the mess left behind by the protagonist when they disappear. And in their place, you teach her that as a maid, she shouldn’t always be thinking about…
theatrical-regression-life:
Theatrical regression life of an old-fashioned villain (kkondae) who recalled his past life.
“There’s nothing I wouldn’t do for a better life.”
——
Survival in the ‘Otherworld’; a place where only the insane can set foot in.
touchline-rebirth-from-fifa-to-football:
Nicholas Marjan—known as Niels—was once an Asian football-obsessed loner in the modern world. A master of FIFA Career Mode, addicted to tactical YouTube breakdowns, and endlessly chasing transfer window drama, he lived the beautiful game from behind a screen.
Until the day he died.
Reborn in the late 2000s in a small European country, Niels wakes up in the body of a once-promising young footballer whose career was tragically cut short by a brutal ACL injury. With no chance to play again, and haunted by the weight of lost potential, the only path forward is through coaching.
Now an assistant at a struggling lower-league club, Niels carries two things no one else has:
-Knowledge of football’s future
-A mysterious cheat-like instinct for scouting raw, hidden talent
As he begins to make waves with his unique coaching style, Niels catches the attention of the football world. Offers from top-tier teams in the top five European leagues come rolling in. With a growing reputation, Niels sets out to transform not just one team's fate—but to leave his mark on the biggest stages in world football.
transcending-the-nine-heavens:
Chu Yang, the Ninth Master of the Nine Tribulations Sword, sacrificed almost everything he had for the sake of improving his martial arts, including the love of his life. After spending three years locating the fifth fragment of the Nine Tribulations Sword, he was ambushed by all sides at that very place. Mortally injured with no means of escape, Chu Yang executed a sacrificial technique by plunging the Nine Tribulations Sword into his very own heart. “With the blood of my heart, ten thousand tribulations will collapse!”
After witnessing the death of all his ambushers, Chu Yang’s vision began to darken. At a distance, moments before his death, he saw the mastermind who had plotted his downfall — Mo Tian Ji. With that, his eyes finally closed.…
transmigrated-as-the-villain-bosss-preci:
[A Lucky Spendthrift FMC VS A Scheming, Black-Bellied MLC | Historical Setting | Everyone's Darling]
The irresistibly cute Tanya Thorne transmigrated into a historical novel as the foolish and clumsy female side character. Her father is a menacing figure who scares the neighbor's kids into silence, her mother is a domineering shrew unmatched in cursing out the entire production brigade, and her three older brothers are local tyrants feared by everyone in Karen Ford and the surrounding hundred miles.
But in front of Tanya Thorne, they all turn into mild-tempered little lambs, only wanting to dote on her, dote on her, and dote on her some more.
In order to change the tragic fate of her family in the book, Tanya Thorne works hard to set her three wayward brothers back on the right path.
“Eldest Brother, the teacher is so fierce. Can you teach me instead?”
“Second Brother, I'm in such poor health. It would be great if I had a genius doctor for a brother.” Tanya Thorne patted her chubby belly, her conscience not bothering her in the least.
“Third Brother, I want to eat lots and lots of meat, but that costs lots and lots of money.…
transmigrated-with-a-movie-tech-system:
Zeke travels through the parallel worlds and activates the Marvel Technology System!
He builds an Iron Man at the start!
Develop Super Soldier Serum in one month!
He invented the Pym Particle in half a year!
With the Marvel Technology System, Zekes' Technology has been directly ahead of the world for hundreds of years!
Follow Zeke and his creations dominate the parallel world!

transmigration-the-tyrant-general-can-he:
PS: THIS IS NOT A SYSTEM BOOK
Camilla Hudson was the world’s most sought-after assassin, known only as “The Black Widow.” After years of bloodshed, hunting down corrupt politicians, she finally collected her final paycheck, laid down her sniper and prepared for a peaceful retirement of luxury and... WebNovels.
But when her favorite story is left on a brutal cliffhanger, Camilla does what any frustrated reader would do: she trashes the author in the comments. “I could do a better job than this!”
The Universe took her literally.
Transmigrated into the body of the pathetic, love-crazed Lady Camilla, the female lead who just attempted suicide over a divorce.
To return to her world, she must give the book an ending and mark it completed. Her plan? Sign the papers, take the money, and leave or she would be stuck inside the story forever.
However, she’s been granted a terrifying new perk—The Cursed Tongue. Every “bad” word she utters becomes a reality.
But there’s a secret perk she doesn't know about: Lord Damon can hear every single one of her murderous, sarcastic thoughts.…
universal-sign-in-ascending-to-godhood-w:
Dustin Walters WAS a coward.
He'll be the first to admit it.
When life got hard, he ran. When his sister went missing, he ran.
When the gang he tried to steal away their 'customers' from caught him mid-negotiation, he tried to run; but this time, he didn't make it.
Beaten, broken, and bleeding out in an alley, Dustin whispered his last words:
“I hope the world gets destroyed. It caused me a lot of pain.”
He meant it as... a joke.
The universe did not.
[Ding! Your dying wish has been granted!]
Resurrected moments before the apocalypse he accidentally caused, Dustin's eyes met the sight of...
[Ding! Daily Sign-in system initializing...]
“A system?”
[Ding! 10x Multiplier system initializing...]
“Two systems??”
[Ding! Leveling System initializing...]
“Great. What a shocker. Three systems.”
Now he's stuck in a monster-infested hellscape of his own making, armed with nothing but a steel pipe, triple cheats, and the burning desire to stop running for once in his miserable life.
The world ended because of him, and now he has to survive it while slowly ascending to the position of a 'guardian,' something that the universe itself calls him.
___
Here's a confusing question.…
viking-invasion:
Rurik, a young man from the 21st century, gets transmigrated to the past—to the 9th century, one of the most savage and bloody eras in history. He awakens as a 15-year-old Norse farmer. Well aware of the harsh life of farmers during this period, from exploitation by lords to constant Viking raids, he chooses to leave the farming life behind.
Rurik embarks on a journey of sailing with the Vikings and commanding raiding parties. This is a slow, somewhat realistic story of rising from a farmer to a Viking lord, and later becoming a noble with territory in Great Britain. Rurik’s most outstanding abilities are his intelligence in handling situations and his strong management skills.
The story also introduces historical figures such as Ragnar, Ivar, Olaf, Björn, Harald, Eric, and many others whose names are recorded in history.
---
Viking tales, while bloody and brutal, are among the most entertaining to read, and I am sure you will have a great time reading this tale.
village-system-blessed-with-the-duty-of-:
Imagine getting struck by lightning, smashing your head against a rock, and waking up with the sudden realization that you’ve been reincarnated into a Stone Age world.
Oh, and there’s a system.
And apparently, Kanan has one job: save everyone before a rival tribe wipes them out.
Burdened with this glorious purpose, Kanan sets out to protect his people and, through a series of events that can only be described as divine nonsense, is blessed with the prestigious role of Village Shaman.
What does a Village Shaman do?
Heal the sick?
Guide the people?
Commune with the gods?
Nope.
Apparently, it’s a divine position that gives one very lucky man the sacred responsibility of breeding all the women in the village.
Kanan wanted to save his people.
The gods, apparently, had other plans.
villains-harem-returns:
Draven Noctaris, Lord Of The Vampires, wakes from a thousand-year sleep, ready to rebuild his harem and save his bloodline from a new threat, but the world is not as he remembers.
His estate is filled with a bunch of new women, but the world is filled with a bunch of new enemies, some stronger than he could have ever expected.
Still, he swears to fix everything and reclaim his spot as strongest in Velhalla. The Noctaris Vampires will rise again, and all will bend to his will. No matter the cost.
when-the-cute-kunoichis-spied-on-their-t:
When The Cute Kunoichis Spied on Their Teacher's Secret is a light novel written by Kazuma Kamachi and illustrated by Ryuushi Tajima.
The story takes place in a world where Japan never ended their isolationist phase, and agents from foreign powers are always threatening to steal the country's advanced technology. In order to combat this threat there has been a resurgence of ninjas that use Strategic Martial Arts, techniques that combine cutting-edge modern technology with a traditional foundation of martial arts and ninjutsu. The story follows Souha Sugiyado, a 17-year old ninja instructor and former ninja prodigy who was forced to retire from active duty by the wounds he suffered in his last mission. Souha's four students are all kunoichi who have all gained the rank of Elite Ninja, the highest official rank available to ninja. However, one day two Shogunate ninja approach him with the news that his four students have gone rogue and have stolen a portable modular nuclear reactor, and thus they ask for his help in bringing his students to justice.
who-says-im-not-a-proper-adventurer:
Transported to a fantasy world filled with Giant Dragons, Elves, and Adventurers, Lance set three iron rules for himself:
Don't join in on the excitement, don't meddle in idle matters, and don't go out after dark.
...
Unexpectedly, a few months after being transported, the unconventional game he played in his past life was still pursuing him.
From then on, Lance possessed endless stamina and an unending life.
But in this world interwoven with adventure, dreams, greed, and danger, he, as a Copyist for the Adventurer's Guild, only wants to live a peaceful life, quietly accumulate strength, and finally go to the City of Trade, full of young ladies from the alien races, to fully display his Talent.
